name: @kodrix/agent-server
description: Unified LLM router for Kodrix IDE — fans out to OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/custom backends behind a single OpenAI-compatible surface.

scripts.build:bundle: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.bundled.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __kodrixCR } from 'node:module'; const require = __kodrixCR(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:android: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.bundled.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __kodrixCR } from 'node:module'; const require = __kodrixCR(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/copy-to-assets.mjs
